blurb: Dolphin 44, also known as Dolphin Snorkeling Cruise, is St. Petersburg’s oldest and largest Egmont Key tour for an unforgettable half-day adventure. Setting sail daily from the St. Petersburg area, we specialize in authentic bottlenose dolphin encounters, guided snorkeling through the historic sunken ruins of Fort Dade, and world-class shelling on the pristine white sands of Egmont Key State Park.
